llm.summary: This is a documentation-only skill for a project-state protocol, with disclosed local persistence and no hidden code or automatic high-impact behavior in the artifact.

dimensions.detail: The skill uses local project-state files and can expose them through an MCP server, which is proportionate to the stated state-layer purpose when scoped to a user-selected .origin package.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The install section references cloning an unspecified repository and running npm verification, so users should confirm the repository source before running commands, but the submitted artifact itself contains no executable installer.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions are user-directed commands for creating, checking, committing to, and diagnosing a named local .origin package; they do not instruct broad filesystem scanning, credential access, or background mutation.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Persistent state is central to the design and is clearly disclosed; writes are described as explicit semantic transactions rather than automatic or hidden persistence.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is to persist project state in explicit .origin packages with provenance, transactions, validation, and MCP access; the described capabilities match that purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only from the intended repository, review the code behind the referenced node commands before use, and run the MCP server only against .origin packages whose project state you are comfortable exposing to connected agents.
